title: Threat Intelligence Analyst
summary: Threat intelligence analysts study who might attack an organisation and how, using threat feeds, open sources and underground forums, and turn this into short reports and indicators the security team can act on. They usually sit in the security operations or cyber defence team and feed the SOC, incident response and vulnerability teams.
dailyDuties: Collect and enrich indicators of compromise from feeds and reports
Monitor open sources, forums and leak sites for threats to the organisation
Map threat actor techniques to MITRE ATT&CK
Search SIEM logs for newly reported indicators
Write intelligence reports and advisories for technical and business readers
Share detection ideas with SOC and detection engineers

skills.expectation: Collect, enrich and assess indicators and threat reports, and track threat actors
Map adversary tactics and techniques to MITRE ATT&CK and suggest detections
Research open sources, underground forums and leak sites for threats to the organisation
Search SIEM logs to check whether reported indicators appear in the environment
Pivot on IP addresses, domains and DNS records to map attacker infrastructure
Write short intelligence reports and advisories for technical and business readers
Weigh sources, judge confidence and separate signal from noise
Do basic static and sandbox analysis of samples
Support incident handlers with intelligence during live cases
Flag exploited vulnerabilities so patching can be prioritised

certifications.why: Covers threat intelligence, detection and analysis at analyst level
Incident handling depth that helps intelligence analysts support responders
Broad security credential for senior analysts
The certification most named in Indian CTI postings.
